title: Prompt library
description: Good example prompts your leader picked out, so the whole team can learn how to ask the agent.
emptyHint: Prompts your leader approves will show up here.
emptyHintLeader: Press "Find example prompts" above to get AI suggestions, then add them to the library.
errorTitle: Could not load the prompt library
finderDescription: Picks high-scoring sessions without serious problems, then asks AI to explain why their first prompt works well. You decide which ones go into the library.
privateNote: Uses your own API key. Team members' prompts are sent to the AI provider (an audit entry is recorded). The search result is visible only to you until you add it to the library.
addKey: Add an AI API key to find example prompts
noneWorthy: Out of {count} sessions considered, the AI found no prompt worth adding to the library.
hideAuthor: Hide the author's name from members

errors.llm_key_invalid: The AI provider rejected the API key.
errors.llm_model_not_found: The selected model does not exist.
errors.llm_quota_exceeded: Quota exhausted or rate limited at the AI provider. Try again later.
